description.zh: 要修改的主机共享密钥的ID。
description.en: The ID of the shared key whose information you want to modify.
The name of the shared key.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。 
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh: 私钥口令（Base64编码后的字符串）。
description.en: The password of the private key. Specify a Base64-encoded string.

description.zh:
私钥（Base64编码后的字符串）。
> 支持输入使用ssh-keygen命令生成的RSA密钥和Ed25519密钥。
description.en:
The private key. Specify a Base64-encoded string.

> Only Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) keys that are generated by using the ssh-keygen command and keys that are generated by using the Ed25519 algorithm are supported.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
